```{r setup, include=FALSE} 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE) 
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, hide=TRUE, warnings=FALSE,message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(parzer)
library(ggrepel)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)
library(ggmap)
ggmap::register_stadiamaps("451495fb-6d1b-45a4-b771-23835d488f11")

bbox <- c(-152.5, 59, -148.5, 62)   # This is roughly Cook Inlet
ak_map <- ggmap::get_stadiamap(bbox, zoom = 9) 

```
  
# Cook Inlet Map

```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.height= 8, fig.width= 12}

wamb <- c("Warren Ames \n Memorial Bridge", 60.526396, -151.209202)
kcbl<-c("Kenai City \n Boat Launch", 60.544149, -151.222913)
tm <- c("Twentymile River", 60.845610, -148.990112)
bp <- c("Bird Point", 60.925917, -149.348249)
mm <- c("93.5 Mile Marker", 60.936718, -149.264467)


alaska_samples <- as.tibble(rbind(wamb,kcbl,tm,bp,mm))
names(alaska_samples) <- c("Site","Lat_deg","Lon_deg")
alaska_samples$Lat_deg <- as.numeric(alaska_samples$Lat_deg)
alaska_samples$Lon_deg <- as.numeric(alaska_samples$Lon_deg)

ggmap(ak_map)  +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Longitude") +
  ylab("Latitude")  +  geom_point(data = alaska_samples, aes(x = Lon_deg, y = Lat_deg)) +
  geom_text(aes(x=-152.6, y=59.55, label="Cook Inlet", ), color="navy",size=10, fontface = "italic")+
  geom_text(aes(x=-150.759679, y=60.57, label="Kenai River", ), color="navy",size=3, fontface = "italic")+
  geom_label(aes(x=-149.5, y=61.226086, label="Anchorage"), size=4,fontface = "bold") +
  geom_point(aes(x=-149.916843, y=61.226086), shape=8, color="red") +
  geom_label_repel(data = alaska_samples, aes(x = Lon_deg, y = Lat_deg, label=Site), box.padding = 1, max.overlaps = Inf) +theme(text = element_text(size = 20))


```
